collections.title: Abstract Algebra · Groups, Rings, and Fields
assumed_background: Arithmetic, elementary algebra, sets/functions and proof habits.

collections.title: Algebra · Modules, Homology, and Resolutions
assumed_background: Groups, rings, modules, kernels/quotients, and linear algebra.

collections.title: Algebra · Commutative Rings, Schemes, and Deformations
assumed_background: Commutative rings and module theory; homological algebra and categories become essential for derived/global sections and obstruction theory.

collections.title: Algebra · Number Fields and Arithmetic Geometry
assumed_background: Field theory, Galois correspondence, module classification and local/complete rings; advanced segments use curve and cohomological methods.

collections.title: Algebra · Representations, Roots, and Combinatorics
assumed_background: Groups and linear algebra; modular and cohomological portions use module/homological foundations.

collections.title: Algebra · Curve Counting and Quantum Geometry
assumed_background: Schemes, sheaf cohomology, intersections, deformation-obstruction theory and derived complexes; this is an advanced route, not a first algebra course.

collections.title: Algebra · Sheaf Counts, Hall Algebras, and Wall Crossing
assumed_background: Derived categories, moduli and deformation-obstruction theory; Hall-algebra and stability examples remain distinct from numerical verification.
